test_title: PYST 1: SSC CGL Tier - II (English) (Held on: 8 Aug 2022)
subject: english
question:
**Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error. If there is no error, select 'No error'.**

The most talented of these three boys are my friend's son.
solution:
The erroneous part is option 4) i.e. 'are my friend's son.'

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• The error lies in the part 'are my friend's son.'
 
• The given sentence talks about a single person **'The most talented' **among three other boys who is my friend's son.
 
• As per the rule of grammar, we have to apply 'be verb' according to the single person.
 
• So, we need to use 'is' instead of 'are' to make the sentence grammatically correct.
 
• Hence, the correct answer is option 4.

 

Correct sentence:__ *The most talented of these three boys **is my friend's son.***
